classification.recurrent_requester.summary: A requester is a recurrent requester if, in the prior 12 months, it submitted to the same public body at least 50 requests, or at least 15 within a 30-day period, or at least 7 within a 7-day period.

classification.voluminous_request.summary: A request is voluminous if it includes more than 5 individual requests for more than 5 different categories of records within 20 business days, or requires compiling more than 500 letter/legal-sized pages (unless a single record exceeds 500 pages).

Disposition.caps.note: Requestor-ledger class-D delivery caps (OH) ride on ledger config; see ledger section.

acknowledgment.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

response.initial_decision_window.summary: A public body must comply with or deny a written request within 5 business days after receipt, unless the time is properly extended.

response.clock_computation.summary: Upon receiving a request, the FOIA officer must note the date the public body received the written request and compute and record the date the response period expires.
response.clock_computation.clock_spec: start event = date written request received; due-date computed per Section 3(d)/(e)

denial.deemed_denial_on_nonresponse.summary: Failure to comply with, extend the time for, or deny a written request within 5 business days after receipt is treated as a denial of the request.
denial.deemed_denial_on_nonresponse.clock_spec: denial deemed at expiry of 5 business-days from request receipt

response.extension_grounds.summary: The requester and the public body may agree in writing to extend the time for compliance for a period determined by the parties.
response.extension_grounds.clock_spec: period agreed in writing by the parties (no statutory cap)

response.extension_length.summary: A public body may extend the response time by not more than 5 business days beyond the original due date for any of seven enumerated reasons.
response.extension_length.clock_spec: ceiling: up to 5 business-days beyond original due date

response.extension_notice.summary: When it extends, the public body must, within 5 business days after receipt, notify the requester of the reasons for the extension and the date the response will be forthcoming.
response.extension_notice.clock_spec: notice due within 5 business-days from request receipt

completion.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

clarification_response.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

nonpayment_close.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

response.classified_request_window.summary: A public body must respond to a request for records to be used for a commercial purpose within 21 working days after receipt.
A public body must respond to a request from a recurrent requester within 21 business days after receipt.
Within 5 business days after receiving a request from a recurrent requester, the public body must notify the requester that it is being treated under the recurrent-requester provisions.
response.classified_request_window.clock_spec: notice due within 5 business-days from request receipt

response.classified_request_window.summary: A public body must respond to a voluminous request within 5 business days after receipt (notifying the requester it is being treated as voluminous).

After the public body's voluminous-request response, the requester must respond within 10 business days; if the requester does not respond (or the request remains voluminous), the public body responds and assesses any fees.
response.classified_request_window.clock_spec: 10 business-days from the public body's response being sent

response.classified_request_window.summary: The public body must give its final voluminous-request response within the earlier of 5 business days after receiving the requester's response or 5 business days after the final day for the requester to respond.
response.classified_request_window.clock_spec: earlier of 5 business-days from requester's response OR 5 business-days from final day for requester to respond

suspension.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

ag_referral.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

fee.electronic_media_charge.summary: For records provided in electronic format, a public body may charge the requester only the actual cost of purchasing the recording medium.

fee.certified_copy_charge.summary: The cost for certifying a record may not exceed $1.

fee.nonstandard_rate.summary: For copies in color or in a size other than letter/legal, a public body may not charge more than its actual cost of reproduction.

fee.commercial_charge.summary: For a commercial request, a public body may charge up to $10 for each hour spent by personnel searching for, retrieving, or examining the record for necessary redactions.

fee.special_service_charge.summary: For a voluminous request for electronic records, a public body may charge tiered caps by data size: for non-PDF data up to $20 (<=2 MB), $40 (2-4 MB), or $100 (>4 MB); for PDF data up to $20 (<=80 MB), $40 (80-160 MB), or $100 (>160 MB).

fee.free_allowance.summary: No fee may be charged for the first 50 pages of black-and-white, letter- or legal-sized copies requested.
No fee may be charged for the first 8 hours spent by personnel searching for or retrieving a requested record on a commercial request.

fee.no_charge_categories.summary: A public body may not charge the requester for the cost of any search for and review of the records.

custody.records_officer_designation.summary: Each public body must designate one or more officials or employees to act as its Freedom of Information officer(s).

response.classified_request_window.summary: The public body must give its final voluminous-request response within the earlier of 5 business days after receiving the requester's response or 5 business days after the final day for the requester to respond.
